speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; I notice you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of your eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, how many hours after birth did you first notice the yellowing?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (due to inadequate intake) OR Breast Milk Jaundice (physiologic), given the onset at 2 weeks of age in an exclusively breastfed infant.

Please confirm if the baby has passed urine and stool normally and if the stools are yellow or clay-colored?
